breakdown.description: The prompt treats the original x–y axes as principal directions even though a nonzero shear stress is present, so the principal stresses are not simply σ_x and 0.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly avoids treating the original x–y axes as principal directions. Instead, it properly applies the principal stress formula σ1,2 = (σx + σy)/2 ± √[((σx - σy)/2)² + τxy²] with the nonzero shear stress τxy = 3 MPa included, yielding σ1 ≈ 10.831 MPa and σ2 ≈ -0.831 MPa. This matches the ground truth approach, which does not claim the principal stresses are simply σ_x and 0 when shear is present.
